mechanism: Tobramycin (aminoglycoside) can cause nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity, and amlodipine may alter renal perfusion through vasodilation, potentially increasing aminoglycoside accumulation and toxicity risk.
action: Monitor serum creatinine, BUN, and tobramycin levels; ensure adequate hydration; assess renal function baseline and during therapy; consider alternative antibiotic if renal impairment develops.
